description: A hiking trail to Secord and Gluten Lakes. A nice day trip or overnight fishing trip. Portions of the trail can be wet, especially in early spring. Approximate one way distance to Secord is 2km, to Gluten roughly 6 km.
directions: Take the Kluskus forest service road to 54.5 km, trail head and parking are on your left.

stats.Activity Details: Snowmobiling, Picnicking, Snowshoeing, Icefishing, Wildlife Viewing, Hiking, Angling

title: Secord-Gluten Lakes
